admission.justification: Source tests cover retained task, diff, review and notes views so a tab visit cannot discard reading state or resurrect a view after its owner truly disappears.

applicability: Operations task, change-set, intent-review and notes views during a visit to another bottom tab and return within the same session.
conditions: Task existence follows membership in the served task population, including a server-carried placeholder.
Pending task hydration retains the view.
After hydration, true absence of the relevant owner dismisses its retained view.
A second press on Operations while already there returns to its task view.
exclusions: Treating an enclosure that survives alone as proof that its owner exists.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §11; dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.operationsDetail.test.tsx :: keeps its selected task view across a visit to another tab; dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.operationsDetail.test.tsx :: keeps the notes reader across a visit to another tab; dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.operationsDetail.test.tsx :: keeps its open diff viewer across a visit to another tab; dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.tabMemory.test.tsx :: his path: three invariants visited, then Chats, Knowledge and Operations: the same page, with no request; dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.tabMemory.test.tsx :: a remembered review comes back when %s, and falls back to the task document otherwise; dashboard/src/cockpit/tabMemory.test.ts :: dismisses $name when its task is gone and its enclosure is still projected

statement: Returning to Operations restores its task, diff, review or notes view while the owning task exists; an absent owner dismisses the view, and pressing Operations again clears it.
